chinese: 允许主持人使用私信 !tts 命令

# english: Configure third party emote handling, changing these requires a restart.
chinese: 配置第三方表情处理，更改后需要重启。

# english: Every spoken phrase will be saved as a WAV file to the folder specified if enabled.
chinese: 启用后，每句朗读内容都会以 WAV 文件保存到指定文件夹。
忽略以下前缀开头的文本

# english: Only say username if previous was different
chinese: 仅在与前一个不同时朗读用户名

# english: Order of replacements is important, and can be re-arranged using ctrl+up/down on a selected replacement.
chinese: 替换顺序很重要，可使用 Ctrl+上/下键对选中的替换项重新排序。

# english: Please do not abuse this, I find this very much like putting words in peoples mouths, as you're giving your viewers a voice.
chinese: 请不要滥用此功能。我认为这就像是替你的观众发声，因为你给了观众一个声音。
将 TTS 音频保存为文件

# english: Speech will be played on the device selected
chinese: 语音将在所选设备上播放

# english: Stop and Skip spoken messages on
chinese: 在以下情况停止并跳过朗读消息

# english: These settings require a restart after changing.
chinese: 这些设置更改后需要重启。

# english: Voices and locales set here will be excluded from random voice selection
chinese: 在此设置的语音和区域将从随机语音选择中排除
